def __init__(self, root, apps, local=None, credentials=None, mail_transport=None):

        self.external['menu'] = self.external_menu

        tools = row('Tools')

                               ('History', self.show_history), ('Backup', self.backup), ('Restore', self.restore)]:
            button(tools, title, command)

        mailbar = row('Email')

        self.columns=('name','family','status','message','checked','successful','duration')
        self.titles=('Application','Suite','Status','Result / Details','Last Checked','Last Successful','Duration (ms)')
        self.tree=ttk.Treeview(frame,columns=self.columns,show='headings',selectmode='extended')
        for key,title,width in zip(self.columns,self.titles,(220,110,90,350,150,150,100)):
            self.tree.heading(key,text=title,command=lambda k=key:self.sort_table(k));self.tree.column(key,width=width,minwidth=70)
        scroll=ttk.Scrollbar(frame,orient='vertical',command=self.tree.yview);self.tree.configure(yscrollcommand=scroll.set)

        self.tree.pack(side='left',fill='both',expand=True);scroll.pack(side='right',fill='y')
        for status,color in [('PASS','#116530'),('FAIL','#a31621'),('WARN','#8a5500'),('MANUAL','#38598b'),('RESTRICTED','#7b397d'),('NOT RUN','#555555')]:self.tree.tag_configure(status,foreground=color)
        for app in apps:
            state=self.history.state(app['app_id']);status='NOT RUN' if app['enabled'] else 'DISABLED'
            self.tree.insert('', 'end',iid=app['app_id'],values=(app['name'],app['family'],status,'Ready' if app['enabled'] else 'Disabled',local_time(state['last_checked']),local_time(state['last_successful']),''),tags=(status,))

        wrapping_label(root, textvariable=self.status, padding=(10, 4))

        prefs=self.settings.value.get('ui',{})

            for key,width in prefs.get('widths',{}).items():
                if key in self.columns:self.tree.column(key,width=int(width))
            if prefs.get('sort') in self.columns:self.sort_reverse=not prefs.get('reverse',False);self.sort_column=prefs['sort'];self.sort_table(prefs['sort'])
